  - Description: Teams are locked in a themed escape room and must solve a series of puzzles and riddles within a time limit to "escape." Success depends on clear communication, delegation, and collaborative problem-solving under pressure.

  - Location: City Escape Rooms
  - Date: 2024-06-12
  - Time: 15:00 - 17:00

  - Description: Team members spend a day volunteering together for a local cause, such as a community garden, food bank, or animal shelter. Work is organized into small mixed teams so colleagues from different areas collaborate.
  - Objective: To strengthen team bonds through shared purpose, boost morale, and give back to the community.
  - Location: Local community center
  - Date: 2024-07-10
  - Time: 09:30 - 13:30
